name: ahoo-cocache-skills
description: Agent Skills for downstream Java/Kotlin applications built on CoCache, the two-level coherent cache (local Caffeine in front of shared Redis): declaring, testing, reviewing and debugging caches, invalidation after commit, Spring Cache, JoinCache and SetCache; upgrading from CoCache 5.x to 6.x; and implementing CoherenceBackend extensions that pass the cocache-test TCK.
